name: Negative Thinking
overview: Scripture teaches that negative thinking is overcome by trusting fully in the Lord rather than leaning on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 exhorts. The believer’s heart must be guarded diligently, for it is the source of life’s outcomes (Proverbs 4:23). When the mind is fixed on God and trust is placed in Him, perfect peace is granted (Isaiah 26:3). Instead of fretting over evildoers or allowing anxious thoughts to dominate, God’s comfort brings delight to the soul amidst many thoughts (Psalms 37:1; Psalms 94:19), reminding us that the Lord as our Shepherd provides all we truly need (Psalms 23:1).
